spoken_words: Sometimes it’s less work to just do the task. I can use AI to build something that does it for me.
native_problem: Correct 21 words, but voice waveform and word timing differed from original audio. Native framing also exposed extra lower torso and desk edge.
finishing: One original-clock Sync v3 restoration, then constant 630x1120 crop at x72,y0 scaled to 720x1280. No temporal edits; restored audio copied.

observations: Sampled final frames preserve full head, near-frontal face and slight right offset.
Stone knit polo, office and supported forward lean remain. The fixed crop removes the desk edge and lower torso.
Sampled glasses, hairline and face geometry appear stable; mouth poses change with speech. A mild closed-mouth smile appears in the final sample.
visual_review.limits: Sampled stills and original-audio correlation do not certify moving likeness, naturalness or visual lip sync throughout. Owner normal-speed playback pending.

observations: Full head and clear top margin preserved; no belly or lap visible.
